There is an old Celtic belief. That when a man dies in a foreign land his spirit returns home
via the "Low Road." In 1745, two Scottish soldiers were made captive in Carlisle. One of whom
was to be set free. The other. Excecuted. It is the condemned man who will return to Scotland
by way of the Low Road of death. And reach Loch Lomond before his friend. Who must travel
